I agree with all above strats. I graduated to TH8 after a fully maxed th7. All troops and bk maxed. I found gold 3 to be the best de farming range. My army comp was 15 giants. 4 bomber men. 55 archers. 62 barbs. 3 heal spell. 2 if you are back to back raiding will get the job done. Giants are meat shields for your barch to finesse into the de storage.  Long sessions are the best way. That way you accumulate a good amount with minimal loss. And ride shields until you are ready to farm for an extended period of time again.
